title: Calibration by kind
goal: work-items calibrate reports bug and feature steps apart and judges each kind against the band
acceptance: byKind groups bug (B-) and feature (F-) samples with the same stats
A kind with at least minSamples and a median outside the band adds its own reason when both kinds have samples
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Implemented 2026-11-12 in about 0.75 agent hours (stated); baseline 1 agent hour judged from F-054-T02, which built the same report.
